verdicts.reason: Three emails labeled día 1, 4 and 10; subjects have 6, 5 and 5 words.
Bodies are about 95 words or fewer, each has one closing question as its request, and usted is used consistently.
Uses the Querétaro opening, the 45 camionetas, Monterrey/Saltillo and the foro on rotación de choferes.
Offers 'casos similares a su operación' (implied unverified clients) and claims routing 'ayuda en la retención', an unapproved result.
Each email has a 'baja' opt-out and [ENLACE AVISO DE PRIVACIDAD]; no false urgency.
